content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe present themselves as integrated solutions for course creators, offering tools for payment processing and course delivery under one roof. However, Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, effectively sidelining countless potential users. Teachable, while robust in features, relies on Stripe for payment processing, further complicating access for creators in restricted regions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, enables creators to leverage free and open-source tools to build their systems. This architecture provides full control over payments and delivery without reliance on platforms that exclude them.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal's limitations reflect a broader issue of accessibility that many digital creators face. PayPal, while more widely available, can suspend accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days without recourse, creating a precarious situation for anyone relying on it for income. This can devastate a creator’s cash flow, especially in countries facing economic challenges. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, does not impose these restrictions. By utilizing decentralized payment options like NOWPayments, creators can transact freely in over 300 cryptocurrencies, bypassing the limitations and ensuring their revenue is secure and accessible.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Both Stripe and PayPal charge transaction fees that can accumulate quickly, especially for smaller transactions. Stripe's fees can be around 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, while PayPal's fees vary significantly. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a low 0.5% fee with no hidden costs, making it far more economical for creators. Also, payments via NOWPayments are verified instantly on-chain, ensuring creators receive their funds without delay. This speed and cost efficiency are crucial for maintaining healthy cash flow, especially for digital products where margins can be tight.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control of your revenue.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of your digital products is a critical concern. Both Teachable and Stripe operate as gatekeepers, holding your data and revenue streams. This means creators are at risk of losing access should they face account issues or platform changes. In stark contrast, with sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators own everything post-deployment. Platforms like Cloudflare Pages and Supabase allow for automated product delivery and order management without third-party interference. This level of control means creators can focus on building their content rather than worrying about platform reliability.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs. For those who need a quick setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack provides essential tools for digital sales in just 48 hours. However, if you're looking for a more comprehensive solution with additional features, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal. It includes advanced capabilities like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email delivery and can handle five products, ensuring a more robust deployment. This flexibility allows creators to scale their operations as their business grows.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure. This allows you to build your own payment and delivery systems without relying on conventional platforms. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you can effectively sell digital products, ensuring you maintain control and ownership of your business.
Avoid platform dependency and preserve ownership of your digital products.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
